title: TP-Link Tapo C410 Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $99 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: TP-Link Tapo C410 Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $99 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[ThiftyCent] Didn't let me purchase 2 x for $99 and price updated to $218 soon after
[babolat360] Damn, been waiting for this deal to come back
[tunzafun001] Can the solar panel be removed from the camera/ battery (2 things you don't want in direct sun).
[theUnderdog] I dont quite understand why you dont want the panel to ve in direct sunlight, its a solar panel after all
But the answer is yes the panel connected to the main unit using an Usb type c cable and you can simply remove and run the camera with the rechargeable battery
[tunzafun001] Panel in the sun is good.
Cameras in direct sun aren't great (lense flair etc).
Lithium batteries in the sun is all bad.
But if they seperate, all good.
Cheers.
[try2bhelpful] In our case the panel is on the upper level of the facade and the camera is under the lintel above the garage. They are connected by a decent length of thin power cable.
[Cookiescream] I need something like this for a building.
Any other recommendations?
Regards
Clarissa
[h3blade] I put it under the roof.
btw. this is not a security camera. it will only catch number plate if very close.
3mp is not enough for face or number recognition
[Marcuspt] Can anyone share a screenshot of the product page at $99 or receipt please? For price protection purposes
[TerryTightwad] You can change the price on your screen by using inspect element in firefox. But most stores dont accept screenshots anymore for this reason.
[vavaroonau] This is back to $99 for anyone who missed it yesterday.
[jonathan111] Got the 2 pack a few months ago,works great, although c660 is better image and can pan and tilt if you can spend the extra !
